title: bug: Unifi integration not working
body:
### Describe the bug

Problems when I try to create the Unifi integration. This is what I'm doing:

1. I've set up a local admin account on my Dream Router.
2. I've conformed that I can login using that account on http://192.168.1.1 (the router's IP) from a browser on the Linux VM where my docker container runs.
3. In Homarr 1.69.1 (1.69.1. was not available in the dropdown, so it says 1.69.0 there), I am creating a new "Unifi Controller" integration using URL http://192.168.1.1
5. I fill in the user name an password as used in step 2 above.
6. I click Test connection and create
...and I get "Creation failed" with the detailed error message
`i: Unable to connect to the integration
caused by Error: write EPROTO D0DD4E96837F0000:error:0A00010B:SSL routines:tls_validate_record_header:wrong version number:../deps/openssl/openssl/ssl/record/methods/tlsany_meth.c:77:
 isAxiosError=true code=EPROTO
caused by Error: write EPROTO D0DD4E96837F0000:error:0A00010B:SSL routines:tls_validate_record_header:wrong version number:../deps/openssl/openssl/ssl/record/methods/tlsany_meth.c:77:
 errno=-71 code=EPROTO syscall=write`
What can be the problem?

### Steps to reproduce

See problem description.

### Impact

Integration does not work at all.

### Additional information

Homarr running in docker container per the official instructions. Here's my compose file:
`services:
  homarr:
    container_name: homarr
    image: ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock # Optional, only if you want docker integration
      - /data/homarr/appdata:/appdata
    environment:
      - SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY=xxx
    ports:
      - '7575:7575'`
I have already set up Radarr, Sonarr, SABnzbd, Qbittorrrent, Home Assistant and Paperless-ngx (some on other servers, some as containers on the same VM) in Homarr without issues.
Homarr beginner since a week or so.

### Version

1.69.0

### Installation method

Portainer

### Browser

Edge (Chromium)

full_comments.body:
